prompts.flat: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: landscape architectural furniture catalogue website image, 1536x1024. Photorealistic editorial furniture photography inspired by restrained USM and String catalogues. Scene: elegant cruise ship gallery, ONE warm white display wall exactly about 2.9 metres wide and 2.9 metres high, pale oak floor, warm white ceiling, large side window with calm open sea visible. Natural daylight and soft shadows. Four very slender vertical silver ladder rails mounted extremely close to the wall, equally spaced across it. Satin royal-blue painted metal modules and tiny royal blue CUBE attachment nodes only 48mm wide, around one fifteenth of a module width, polished metal connectors. Camera front three-quarter at 40mm, landscape framing, show entire wall floor to ceiling and side window, realistic modest module scale. Modules are wall-hung on rails, not freestanding. No people, branding, captions, dimensions, UI, logos or text. Avoid spherical joints, oversized blue blocks, industrial scaffolding, freestanding cabinets. Conceptual interior render, not engineering diagram. Display arrangement: three extremely thin rectangular photographic panels, each 720mm wide by 576mm tall, attached to rails at their four corners with the tiny blue cube nodes. Place one at upper left, one at mid centre, one at upper right; photographs are minimalist monochrome sea and coast art without text. Two small directional lamps above illuminate panels. Plenty of clear wall around the panels.
